movements.name: Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back in a rack and stand with feet around hip width.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, and lower your heels under control.
Record the total barbell weight, including the bar and plates.
coachingCues: Keep your torso steady and avoid bouncing.
Use a consistent range of motion for each repetition.

movements.name: Wall Push-up
instructions: Stand facing a wall with straight arms and hands around chest height.
Bend the elbows to bring the chest toward the wall, then press back to straight arms.
coachingCues: Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Let the shoulder blades move naturally.

movements.name: Incline Push-up
instructions: Place both hands on a stable elevated surface and step back into a straight-body plank.
Lower the chest under control, then press the surface away.
coachingCues: Keep ribs and hips stacked.
Choose an elevation that preserves full range.

movements.name: Knee Push-up
instructions: Start with hands beneath the shoulders and knees on the floor.
Lower chest and hips together, then press to full elbow extension.
coachingCues: Maintain one line from knees to head.
Do not leave the hips behind.

movements.name: Assisted Pull-up
instructions: Set enough assistance to begin from straight arms with control.
Pull the chest toward the bar, then lower to full arm extension.
coachingCues: Start by drawing the shoulder blades down.
Use the least assistance that keeps every rep controlled.

movements.name: Eccentric Pull-up
instructions: Step or jump to the top position with the chin above the bar.
Lower to straight arms over a controlled count before resetting.
coachingCues: Own the full descent.
Stop the set when lowering speed cannot be controlled.

movements.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip the bar and hang with straight elbows and feet clear of the floor.
Maintain a comfortable shoulder position for the prescribed time.
coachingCues: Keep a secure full grip.
End the set if the shoulder position becomes painful.

movements.name: Scapular Push-up
instructions: Hold a straight-arm plank without bending the elbows.
Let the shoulder blades come together slightly, then push the floor away to spread them.
coachingCues: Move only through the shoulder blades.
Keep ribs and pelvis steady.

movements.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean the back against a wall and walk the feet forward.
Slide down to a controlled squat depth and hold without pushing on the thighs.
coachingCues: Keep pressure through the whole foot.
Choose a knee angle you can hold without pain.

movements.name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Begin in a straight-arm plank.
Drive one knee toward the chest and alternate legs at the prescribed pace.
coachingCues: Keep shoulders over hands.
Limit hip movement as speed increases.

movements.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with feet around hip width.
Rise onto the balls of the feet, pause, and lower the heels under control.
coachingCues: Reach full height without rolling the ankles.
Use a wall lightly for balance if needed.

movements.name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Clean the bar from the floor and stand to full extension in the front rack.
Reset the feet and breath, then drive the bar overhead with the prescribed jerk style.
coachingCues: Finish the clean before setting up the jerk.
Recover with the bar stacked over the middle of the body.

movements.name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Hold the bar in the front rack and descend into a full front squat.
Stand aggressively and continue the leg drive into an overhead lockout.
coachingCues: Keep the bar supported through the squat.
Make the squat and press one continuous drive.

movements.name: Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Start with one dumbbell between the feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive through the floor and guide the dumbbell to a stable overhead lockout in one motion.
coachingCues: Keep the dumbbell close to the body.
Finish with ribs down and elbow locked.

movements.name: Dumbbell Clean and Jerk
instructions: Clean one dumbbell from the floor or hang to the shoulder.
Dip and drive it to a stable overhead lockout before returning under control.
coachingCues: Receive the clean softly at the shoulder.
Use the legs before pressing with the arm.

movements.name: Wall Walk
instructions: Begin prone with feet at the wall and hands near the shoulders.
Walk the feet up and hands toward the wall, then reverse under control to the floor.
coachingCues: Take short controlled hand steps.
Keep the trunk braced as the body becomes vertical.

movements.name: Handstand Walk
instructions: Kick to a balanced handstand with locked elbows.
Shift weight from hand to hand and take small steps while maintaining a stacked position.
coachingCues: Look between the hands.
Move from controlled weight shifts, not a falling chase.

movements.name: Box Jump-over
instructions: Jump onto the box with both feet and establish control.
Travel over the box and step or jump down on the opposite side as prescribed.
coachingCues: Land with the whole foot on the box.
Use a repeatable height when fatigue rises.

movements.name: Burpee Box Jump-over
instructions: Complete a burpee facing or beside the box as prescribed.
Jump onto and travel over the box before beginning the next repetition.
coachingCues: Use a consistent approach to the box.
Step down when jumping down would compromise control.

movements.name: Paused Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to a stable touch point on the chest.
Hold motionless for the prescribed pause, then press to lockout.
coachingCues: Keep upper-back tension during the pause.
Do not let the bar sink before pressing.

movements.name: Tempo Bench Press
instructions: Unrack with the upper back set and elbows locked.
Lower according to the prescribed tempo, touch consistently, and press normally unless instructed otherwise.
coachingCues: Count the tempo evenly.
Keep the bar path consistent as speed slows.

movements.name: Weighted Chin-up
instructions: Hang from the bar with a supinated grip and the external load secured.
Pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower to straight arms under control.
coachingCues: Keep the added load quiet.
Use the same start and finish standard every set.

movements.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit securely and take an even grip with arms extended overhead.
Pull the attachment toward the upper chest, then return to full arm extension under control.
coachingCues: Drive elbows down rather than leaning back.
Keep the neck relaxed.

movements.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with the cable under tension and arms extended.
Pull the handle toward the torso, pause briefly, and return without losing posture.
coachingCues: Lead with the elbows.
Avoid turning the finish into a backward lean.

movements.name: Leg Press
instructions: Set the seat so the hips and back remain supported through a comfortable depth.
Lower the platform under control and press through the feet without locking the knees aggressively.
coachingCues: Keep knees tracking with toes.
Use the same depth and machine setup each session.

movements.name: Leg Curl
instructions: Align the machine pivot with the knee and secure the pad above the heel.
Curl through the available range, pause, and return the weight under control.
coachingCues: Keep the hips stable.
Do not let the weight stack drop between reps.

movements.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Align the machine pivot with the knee and place the lower pad above the ankle.
Extend the knees smoothly, pause near the top, and lower under control.
coachingCues: Keep the hips against the seat.
Use a pain-free range without swinging.

movements.name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand with the attachment held near the lower chest and elbows close to the sides.
Extend the elbows fully, then return until the forearms rise without moving the upper arms.
coachingCues: Keep shoulders quiet.
Finish by straightening the elbows, not leaning over the handle.
